<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The buttons at the end of a top bar: login, the call to action and the theme button (it only reports the
  press). No wrapper: they sit in the row of the bar.
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type NavActionsProps = {
  login?: string;
  loginHref?: string;
  cta?: string;
  ctaHref?: string;
  actions?: "none" | "cta";
  tone?: "default" | "inverse";
  themeLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import { urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  login,
  loginHref,
  cta,
  ctaHref,
  actions = "cta",
  tone = "default",
  themeLabel,
} = defineProps<NavActionsProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ theme: [] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <Button v-if="login"
    variant="ghost"
    size="sm"
    :href="urlOf(loginHref)"
    :class="(((tone as string) === 'inverse') ? 'text-background hover:bg-background/10' : '')"
    data-testid="nav-login"
  >
    {{ login }}
  </Button>
  <Button v-if="(((actions as string) === 'cta') && cta)"
    :variant="(((tone as string) === 'inverse') ? 'secondary' : 'default')"
    size="sm"
    :href="urlOf(ctaHref)"
    data-testid="header-cta"
  >
    {{ cta }}
  </Button>
  <Button v-if="themeLabel" variant="outline" size="sm" data-testid="theme-toggle" @click="() => emit('theme')">
    {{ themeLabel }}
  </Button>
</template>
